- **Stephen Curry (2014-15 through 2016-17 Regular Seasons)**: Across 3 covered seasons, Curry accumulated 4,865.56 shooting opportunities with a shot-opportunity-weighted rTS of +10.20 percentage points above contemporary league average (`ev_ab58a35e174535e824b7`).
- **Season-by-Season Bryant Benchmarks**: 
  - 2005-06: Player TS% 55.89%, League TS% 53.56%, rTS +2.34 pts (2,533.36 opp) (`ev_a72b7d9d01f10f1f989e`).
